[[File:Ironman tutor (Tutorial Island) chathead.png|left]]
'''Paul''' the '''Ironman tutor''' is found on [[Tutorial Island]], and teaches new players about [[Ironman Mode]]. He can change the player's Ironman status freely before they leave Tutorial Island. Another Ironman tutor, [[Ironman tutor|Adam]], is found in [[Lumbridge]] and can help players downgrade or lock their Ironman status once off Tutorial Island.

The player may also choose to create a [[Group Ironman Mode|Group Ironman]] with other players when selecting their Ironman status. Paul will then instruct the player to continue to the tutorial and visit [[The Node]]. 
[[File:Ironman Setup interface.png|right|thumb|The menu for selecting the mode the player wishes to play.]]
